subject: Medford Jazz Festival 2025 Opening Day
overview: Organizers opened the 2025 Medford Jazz Festival at the West Medford Community Center with organizational updates followed by a live performance. The session included a set of jazz standards by AJ and the Crew and technical coordination for the weekend's broadcast.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Schedule
items.summary: Terry Carter opened the festival and invited the public to attend the full slate of events scheduled for the upcoming Saturday and Sunday.

items.title: Organizational Report and Community Planning
items.summary: Speaker 08 discussed the festival's diversified social media presence and thanked local volunteers for their roles in community planning and promotion.

items.title: Sponsorship and Venue Logistics
items.summary: Organizers highlighted the support of generous sponsors and identified the West Medford Community Center as the primary venue for arts and education.

items.title: Broadcast Production Coordination
items.summary: Production staff from Medford Community Media coordinated camera angles, streaming audio quality, and lighting setups for the televised festival coverage.

items.title: Musical Performance: AJ and the Crew
items.summary: The ensemble AJ and the Crew performed a set of jazz standards including "East of the Sun", "Over the Rainbow", and "Sway."

items.title: Closing Remarks and Future Program
items.summary: Jonathan Fagan thanked Morningside Music Studio for their ensemble contributions and reviewed the upcoming performance schedule for the remainder of the weekend.
